title: feat(console): the row and record-page Delete confirmations name the objects a delete cascades into, from the served cascadeDeleteObjects
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvGtYbnKXjz3iks1AW

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao496Uyi2VsF6sZMEh4MGR9S)_

Fixes #28472

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：列表行删除、批量删除和记录页删除的确认框，在平台下发 `cascadeDeleteObjects` 非空时多一句话，按当前语言的对象名称列出会被一并删除的子对象（例如删除线索会一并删除「Campaign Member」记录）。
- 为什么改：#28001 裁决 B 的 UI 半边；服务端已在 #28451 下发该列表，但 Console 的数据层把它丢了，用户删除时不知道会连带删掉子记录。
- 风险与回滚：只加一句文案；列表为空或未下发时文案与今天逐字相同；Console 不自行推导级联。回滚即整体 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/core/src/actions/recordDelete.ts`（`confirmCopy` 追加一句）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useObjectActions.ts`（`resolveCascadeDeleteLabels` 按名读对象 schema）、`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`（`fetchObjectSchemaFresh` 保留信封里的列表）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useObjectActions.deleteCascade-28472.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.deleteCascade-28472.test.tsx`，预期 2 个文件 9 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The platform serves `cascadeDeleteObjects` beside `item` on the by-name object read and on the app bundle's object entries (#28451). It never reached a confirmation, for two measured reasons:

1. `@object-ui/data-objectstack` `fetchObjectSchemaFresh` unwraps `item` and drops the envelope's siblings (only `sortability` and `disabledActions` were re-attached).
2. Both Console hosts pass the `objectDef` from `useMetadata().objects`, which is the LIST read, where the server never serves the key.

The change:

- **`@object-ui/core`**: new `utils/cascade-delete-objects.ts` with `CASCADE_DELETE_OBJECTS_KEY`, `attachCascadeDeleteObjects` and `readCascadeDeleteObjects`, the twin of `attachObjectSortability`: a non-enumerable symbol, so a schema written back to a metadata endpoint never carries the list. `[]` stays `[]`; absent stays `undefined`. `recordDelete.confirmCopy` takes an optional `cascadeLabels` and appends one sentence (`objectActions.deleteCascade`) to the body, for one record and for a batch. Empty or absent adds nothing.
- **`@object-ui/data-objectstack`**: `fetchObjectSchemaFresh` attaches the envelope's `cascadeDeleteObjects`. The app-bundle path answers the same envelope, so it is covered by the same line.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`**: `useObjectActions` exports `resolveCascadeDeleteLabels(dataSource, objectName, labelOf)`, which reads the by-name schema (`dataSource.getObjectSchema`, already cached by the adapter because the grid and the record form read it) and maps the served names to labels; a failed read answers `undefined`. `useObjectActions` takes an optional `objectLabelOf`; `views/ObjectView.tsx` passes one (the `objects` entry through `useObjectLabel().objectLabel`, else the name), and `views/RecordDetailView.tsx` uses the same helper in its `sys_delete` confirm. Both host edits are a few lines.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`**: `objectActions.deleteCascade` in all ten built-in catalogs.
- `plugin-grid` is untouched: it has no confirm of its own, it hands the row to the host's `onDelete`.

No author key (ruling B item 1), and no client copy of the cascade rule (triage 6549643166).

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useObjectActions.deleteCascade-28472.test.tsx` (row and selection, real `I18nProvider`, strings read from the packs by key): list `['crm_campaign_member']` adds one line naming `Campaign Member` (en and zh), `[]` adds nothing, absent adds nothing, a failed schema read adds nothing, the batch question gains the same line.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.deleteCascade-28472.test.tsx` (the real record page and the real `ActionConfirmDialog`): list adds one line naming its label, `[]` and absent leave the body exactly today's question.
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/getObjectSchema.cascadeDeleteObjects-28472.test.ts`: the envelope's list is carried, off enumerable keys and out of `JSON.stringify`; `[]` stays `[]`; absent stays absent.
- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/recordDelete.cascade-28472.test.ts`: `confirmCopy` with and without labels, batch, and the carried-key pair.

Ablation (one run, not kept): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the reader in `resolveCascadeDeleteLabels` (the `readCascadeDeleteObjects(schema)` map) with a bare return. The two host files went 4 failed, 5 passed: every list-positive pin red (row en, row zh, batch, record page), every `[]` / absent / failed-read pin green. Restored, blob back to the HEAD blob `7742aef6`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Bulk delete gets the line too.** It asks through the same `confirmCopy` and deletes records that cascade the same way (seat ruling in claim amendment 6550299396).
- **`plugin-view`'s own `ObjectView` delete dialog is unchanged.** It also calls `confirmCopy`, but passes no `cascadeLabels`, so it keeps today's text. The Console list route uses `app-shell`'s `ObjectView`.
- **Labels.** A cascade object the Console's `objects` list holds is named by its translated label; one it does not hold (a scoped record route lists only the objects the page binds) falls back to the translation bundle's label, else its name.
- **Separator.** Labels are joined with a comma and a space in every language.
- `RecordDetailView.tsx` and `ObjectView.tsx` are also edited by PR #28477 and sibling #28461; the edits here are a few lines each.
- **main-red fix carried:** ba0084e4 (#28467) added ActionSchema.overrides without the ui inventory entry; actionKeys.pin red on main for every ui PR. `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` in `ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionKeys.ts` gains `'overrides'` (restates the spec key; `ActionDef` does not declare it, the runner does not read it). On head `4e795d9e` (main merged at `9b4d1933`): `packages/core/src/actions/` 51 files, 717 tests passed; with the entry deleted (`ablation-replace.mjs`) the pin reds with `missing: ['overrides']`.

## Verification

All on head `e1ded0b8` (main base `768ec4bf`), except the main-red fix above, measured on `4e795d9e`.
